commit_message:
decomp: complete worldmap camera code (A2DE 4.304467%)

Reconstruct all 12 configured WorldMapCamera functions: destruction, task
dispatch/state transitions, camera update, rendering, creation and factory.
Recover the View matrix initialization and Vec3_32 conversion needed for the
original MWCC code generation, plus the View/PerspView/camera symbol boundaries.

Add 2,784 matching code bytes and 12 matching functions over 76daeb8.
Totals: 123,816 / 2,876,454 code bytes and 1,453 / 15,667 functions.
Matching data remains 4,276 / 851,344. No previously matching code or
function is lost. Camera code is 100%; its data range is not yet complete.

The full source build and local objdiff report pass. Public CI recompiles the
sources and reproduces the 12-function code/reference fingerprint before
publishing. No ROM or extracted original game binaries are included.
